newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume eases, prices rise.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume eases, prices rise.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange dived to 1,400 kg on Friday on easing demand after jumping to 2,602 kg on Thursday, dealers said.
Gold closed firmer at $343.50 an ounce from $341.90 on Thursday, following trends in world markets, and rose to 1,484,500 lira per gram from yesterday's 1,476,000 lira.
Brokers said most of the day's trade was due to banks registering imported gold on the exchange to be able to sell it to non-member gold traders outside the bourse later.
Gold volume had jumped on Thursday as post-holiday demand boosted activity in the free market.

Of the day's trade, 1,000 kg took place in the morning session when world prices were easier and 400 kg in the afternoon. 50 percent of the trade was in lira terms. -- Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
